structure.note: Three classes: Class A (one vote), Class B (ten votes) and Class F, all 1,005,000 shares of which sit in the Founder Voting Trust for Stephen Cohen, Alexander Karp and Peter Thiel (335,000 each). The Class F vote is set so that the proxy's 'Founder Total' (shares under the Founder Voting Agreement, the trust's Class F shares and Thiel's Designated Founders' Excluded Shares) carries 49.999999% of the vote. Thiel's own shares carry 8.1% of the votes excluding Class F. The 10-K says Palantir is 'currently not considered to be a controlled company' under Nasdaq rules.

OWNERSHIP: the proxy gives Thiel 3.1% of Class A, 30.3% of Class B, a third of Class F and 8.1% of votes, but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 4.25% economic share is in leader.derived. Class F is counted on both sides because the 10-K says all classes share dividend and liquidation rights equally; excluding it would give 4.24% instead of 4.25%. Thiel holds through PLTR Holdings LLC, STS Holdings II LLC, Rivendell 7 LLC and Rivendell 25 LLC; 10,635,784 of his Class A shares are pledged, and 55,137,931 Class A plus 2,962,961 Class B shares are 'Designated Founders' Excluded Shares' outside the Founder Voting Agreement. pctVoting 8.1 is the proxy's figure for his own Class A and B shares and excludes the Class F votes; the three founders together control 49.999999%. 5% HOLDERS: the proxy states Vanguard (9.8%) and BlackRock (7.0%) as % of Class A only; on an all-shares basis they would be slightly lower (Class A is about 95.9% of all shares). They are recorded as stated, not recomputed. Their percentages of votes are 4.9% and 3.5%. The footnotes give only 13G/A filing dates (Jan 31, 2025 and Nov 8, 2024), not ownership dates, so holder asOf is omitted. No dividends: the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. Buybacks of $64.2 million were cash paid under the share repurchase program; $218.3 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of equity awards is excluded. No broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K, so plan is null.
